subject: Gradual duty resumption & temporary shift adjustments for Emma Turner
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Turner <emma.turner@example.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Gradual duty resumption & temporary shift adjustments for Emma Turner

Hi Monica / Laura,

Quick context: Emma (Sr. ML Eng, Platform) is scheduled to return from surgery around 20 Jul, but her clinician recommends a phased resumption with reduced hours and no on-call for the first 4–6 weeks. Emma flagged this in her last check-in and sent the note to me (attached).

As Emma's manager I want to put a concrete, time-bound plan in place so we can:
- Preserve coverage for production alerts and on-call rotations
- Keep Emma productive with lower-impact, asynchronous work (code review, design docs, paired debugging as tolerated)
- Avoid last-minute escalations to other teams

Requesting:
1) Monica — can you confirm what documentation HR needs on file to formalize a temporary modified schedule (FMLA forms, medical release, ADA accommodation paperwork)? I attached the initial note Emma provided.
2) Laura — can we temporarily reassign Emma's critical on-call shifts for the next 6 weeks? If so, I'll propose who covers and for how long.
3) All — please review the attached draft schedule (I'll share an updated spreadsheet once we confirm).

I've cc'd Emma so she's in the loop. Happy to join a quick sync next week to lock this down.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Platform ML
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: medical_note_2026-07-08.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Turner <emma.turner@example.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gradual duty resumption & temporary shift adjustments for Emma Turner

Thanks for the heads-up, Rishi — and hi Emma. Hope you're doing okay.

Next steps from HR's side:
- We need a formal clinician note that includes the expected limitations and a return-to-work clearance date (or a tentative window). The attached HR checklist outlines acceptable documentation.
- For a temporary schedule/ADA accommodation we typically require: the medical documentation, a manager accommodation proposal (what duties/hours are changing), and the employee's acknowledgement.
- FMLA: if Emma requests it, please have her submit the FMLA intake (link below). If she doesn't want FMLA, we can still process an ADA-style accommodation.

Operational suggestions:
- Reduced hours: start with 60% for the first two weeks, reassess weekly with occupational health input.
- No on-call or triage duties for 4–6 weeks; handle critical alerts via a buddy system with a named backup.
- Reassign any scheduled on-call in the calendar now to avoid late swaps.

If you can draft a one-page manager proposal (what Emma will / won't do, proposed coverage, expected duration), I can route it through HR and get an official accommodation agreement ready.

Links: HR return checklist (attached), FMLA intake form: https://hr.redwood.ai/forms/fmla-intake

Happy to do a brief call Monday 13 Jul at 2pm PT if that helps.

—Monica
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: hr-return-checklist.pdf (PDF, 80KB)]

From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@example.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gradual duty resumption & temporary shift adjustments for Emma Turner

Thanks both — appreciate the quick coordination and the flexibility. A few clarifications from my end:
- I will attach the clinician letter that lists limitations: no lifting >10lbs, no overnight shifts, and limited standing >30 mins.
- My energy is currently best for 4–5 hours/day of focused work; I can do async code review, documentation, and pair-program for short blocks.
- I cannot perform on-call triage or be scheduled for overnight incidents for at least 6 weeks.

I'm attaching the clinician letter now. If we can formalize a schedule where I do mornings for heads-down tasks and leave afternoons for follow-ups, that would work well. I'm happy to be flexible on exact hours as long as the overnight/on-call restriction is respected.

Thanks again — I want this to be smooth for the team.

—Emma Turner
Senior ML Engineer (Platform)
[Attachment: medical_note_2026-07-08.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Turner <emma.turner@example.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gradual duty resumption & temporary shift adjustments for Emma Turner

Okay — thanks everyone, this is actionable. Summary and next steps (agreed items):

1) Documentation: Monica will file the accommodation once she has the clinician letter + the one-page manager proposal. (Monica: I'll attach the proposal in this thread tonight.)
2) Schedule & duties: Emma will start Weds 21 Jul on a 5hr/day morning-focused schedule for two weeks, then move to 6hrs/day for weeks 3–4, with a health check the week of 4 Aug to reassess. No on-call for at least 6 weeks.
3) Coverage: Alex — can you take Emma's on-call shifts for the next four rotations? If you prefer a partial handoff, we'll split across Alex and Laura's team.
4) Ticket triage: I'll move Emma's high-priority tickets into a 'do-not-assign' pool and reassign to the coverage list; Emma will continue reviews.

Attached is the proposed_shift_schedule_2026-07-18.xlsx and a one-page manager proposal I drafted. If Monica confirms the paperwork path, please route the accommodation agreement for signatures. Emma — please confirm you’re okay with the schedule above and we’ll publish the calendar entries.

Appreciate the team moving quickly on this.

Rishi
Director, Platform ML
Redwood Inference
